plan.phone_source: Reserved fictional demonstration number; never dial.
plan.objective: Return coffee grinder; obtain the confirmation and next steps.
plan.opening: Hello, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Alex Demo. May I record and transcribe this conversation to help them follow up?

dialogue.after_recording_consent: Please help return the coffee grinder, order DEMO-1234. The reason is: It arrived damaged..
dialogue.verification: The account holder can complete verification directly. Please hold.
dialogue.if_cancellation_unavailable: Please explain the return options, fees, deadline, and refund method. Do not initiate a different action yet.
dialogue.confirm: Please confirm the exact item, any fees, refund method, and next steps before proceeding.
dialogue.close: Please give me the case or confirmation number. Thank you for your help.

allowed_actions: Request return of this exact item only
Ask for confirmation and next steps
stop_conditions: Account holder must complete identity verification
Any fee, purchase, subscription, or different item/action is proposed
Recording is declined: stop recording; let the user decide how to continue
The representative requires a human account holder
success_criteria: Representative explicitly confirms return status for the specified item
Record reference number, refund details, and any remaining user actions
